name: Anonymous FTP login allowed
description: 172.31.250.10 TCP/21 accepts anonymous FTP login (nmap ftp-anon, FTP code 230).

name: Redis accessible without authentication
description: 172.31.250.11 TCP/6379 answered Redis INFO without credentials (nmap redis-info).

name: HTTP directory listing enabled
description: 172.31.250.12 TCP/80 serves auto-generated directory listings at /, /files/ (nmap http-enum).

name: Deprecated TLS protocol offered (TLSv1.0/TLSv1.1)
description: 172.31.250.12 TCP/443 accepts TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1 (TLS 1.0 / TLS 1.1 or older) per nmap ssl-enum-ciphers.

name: Weak TLS cipher suites offered (least strength F)
description: 172.31.250.12 TCP/443 offers weak cipher suites (e.g. anonymous/NULL/EXPORT/RC4/3DES); nmap ssl-enum-ciphers least strength F.

name: Self-signed TLS certificate
description: 172.31.250.12 TCP/443 presents a self-signed certificate (subject == issuer: commonName=weak-tls.lab.local/organizationName=Evergreen LAB).

name: Weak TLS certificate key (RSA 1024-bit)
description: 172.31.250.12 TCP/443 certificate uses a RSA 1024-bit key (below 2048).

name: SMB guest access allowed
description: 172.31.250.13 TCP/445 accepted an SMB session as guest (nmap smb-security-mode account_used=guest).

name: SMB message signing not required
description: 172.31.250.13 TCP/445 does not require SMB message signing (nmap smb2-security-mode), enabling NTLM relay.

name: Database account with empty password
description: 172.31.250.14 TCP/3306 database account(s) root accept an empty password (mysql-empty-password).

name: Self-signed TLS certificate
description: 172.31.250.14 TCP/3306 presents a self-signed certificate (subject == issuer: commonName=MariaDB Server).
